apps.name: Photos Backup
apps.localizedDescription:
## New

- **The Google Photos app now counts what this app backs up.** ([#24](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/pull/24), thanks @saileshbro) Uploads showed as "not backed up" in the Google Photos app, and its own **Free up space** never offered them. It now recognises them, and its **Free up space** and **Delete from device** remove the photos from your iPhone. On one library of about 8,500 items, "Not backed up" went from 8,145 to 0 and **Free up space** from 2 items to 461.

  The reason was the version being uploaded. The Google Photos app only counts a photo it can match to the one on your iPhone, so an **edited** photo or video now backs up as it looks, not as its unedited original. A photo you edited in the Google Photos app also needs the version that edit was applied on, which is uploaded in an extra step.

- **Back Up Live Photo Motion.** Off by default. With it on, a Live Photo's motion is attached to the still already in your account, so it plays as a Live Photo and **Free up space** will offer it. Live Photos backed up earlier get their motion added as a backlog — this can be tens of GB, which is why it is a setting you turn on.

- **Backup keeps going after you leave the app (iOS 26).** While the app is open with work to do, iOS is asked to keep it running; progress then shows in a Live Activity, where you can also stop it. Up to 2 uploads run at once in the background. On earlier iOS versions nothing changes.

## Fixed

- **Automatic Backup never ran in the background on SideStore installs.** This affected every sideloaded install and was not new in this release. SideStore renames the app when it signs it, so the background task the app registered no longer matched the one it declared, and iOS refused it — meaning **Automatic Backup never got a background window at all**. The app now reads the name from its own build. ([#2](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/issues/2))

- **Google's rate limit no longer fails a row.** When Google asked the app to slow down (HTTP 429), rows retried a second apart, met the same refusal, and failed. The whole queue now waits it out — a minute, doubling up to ten while Google keeps refusing — and carries on.

- **Items marked "Cancelled" with no reason.** ([#19](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/issues/19)) If the app was interrupted part way through an item, that row was marked "Cancelled" and left with nothing to explain it and nothing to retry it, which is why the same photo could appear as both "Cancelled" and "Already backed up". An interruption now retries, and if it keeps happening it says what went wrong. "Cancelled" now only ever means you stopped it, and reads **Stopped by you**.

- **The activity list got faster on big backups.** ([#8](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/issues/8)) As each item finished, the app was asking the photo library about it twice on the same thread that draws the list. It asks once now.

- **Photos deleted while still queued.** Freeing space on your iPhone deletes photos that may still be waiting to upload. Those rows are dropped quietly instead of failing with "no longer in your photo library" — about 2,000 rows had failed that way on one library.

## What's Changed in v1.3.2 🚀

This update brings full feature parity with AirCard macOS v1.2.6, restores robust card discovery across all iOS versions, introduces automatic bank/network recognition with custom card nicknames, delivers an ultra-fast tunnel cache (0.02s connections), and completely resolves wallpaper flashing for Collections and Mercury wallpapers.

### 💳 Wallet Card Discovery & Bank Identification
• **Universal Wallet Log Parser**: Ported the proven `WalletScanParser` from AirCard macOS. Captures cards from `Dashboard loading (...): for SOO+`, `passIDs[InSession]`, `passIDs[global]`, and modern JSON NFC activations (`"identifier": "HEX"`).
• **Automatic Bank & Network Detection**: Recognizes Visa, Mastercard, American Express, UnionPay, Discover, and JCB via applet AIDs during selection.
• **Card Nicknames (Rename)**: Added a direct **Rename** button (✏️) so you can give your cards friendly names like *"Monobank"*, *"Salary Card"*, or *"Revolut"*, safely persisted in app settings.
• **28-Character Fallback Token Matcher**: Restores dependable card discovery on devices where standard log patterns are redacted.

### ⚡ Ultra-Fast Tunnel Routing (from 10s to 0.02s!)
• **Working Route Caching**: `rust-core` now caches the active RSD connection route (`LAST_WORKING_ROUTE`), eliminating repeated port and interface scanning.
• **RSD-First Priority**: Connects directly via RemoteXPC on port 49152, bypassing slow Lockdown retries and broken pipes on iOS 18+.
• **Eliminated Loopback Policy Drops**: Removed local loopback attempts that caused `policy drop` control channel errors.

### 🖼 Wallpapers (.tendies) — Collections & Mercury Fixes
• **Dual Injection on iOS 18+**: Wallpapers are now injected into both their primary bundle (`com.apple.WallpaperKit.CollectionsPoster` or `com.apple.MercuryPoster`) and the modern iOS 18+ application container (`com.apple.Posters.CollectionsPosterApp` / `com.apple.Posters.MercuryPosterApp`).
• **Metadata Synchronization**: Fixed a critical issue where `Wallpaper.plist`'s numeric identifier was randomized out-of-sync with `suggestionMetadata.plist` (`7400.DYNAMIC`), causing wallpapers like Windows 11 to vanish from the Lock Screen gallery.
• **Mercury Wallpaper Support**: Added recognition for `mercury-descriptors` container folders and registered `com.apple.Posters.MercuryPosterApp` in `PersistedPosterContainerBundleIdentifiers`.
• **NeoSpring Respring**: Instant springboard reload to apply wallpaper preferences immediately.

### 🧪 Quality & Testing
• All 24 unit tests passing (`TendiesEngineTests`, `WalletScanParserTests`, `CardPhotoCropTests`, `CardPhotoPickerTests`).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Mak5er/AirCard-iOS/compare/v1.3.1...v1.3.2

## What's Changed in v1.3.1

### 📲 Pairing File Import (iOS 18 – iOS 26 Support!)
• **SideStore & LiveContainer Pairing File Support**: You can now import pairing files (`.mobiledevicepairing`, `.plist`, `.mobilepair`) directly from SideStore, LiveContainer, iLoader, AltStore, Jitterbug, or PC/Mac.
• **No iOS 27 Required**: Users on iOS 18.0 through iOS 26 can now fully use AirCard-iOS by simply importing their pairing file from SideStore or LiveContainer.
• **Safe Unpair / Reset**: Added a dedicated "Delete Pairing / Unpair" button to reset or switch pairing configurations without having to reinstall the app.
• **In-App Pairing Guide**: Added a step-by-step setup guide sheet with exact paths to locate pairing files in the Files app (e.g. `SideStore/ALTPairingFile.mobiledevicepairing`).
• **iOS 27+ Gated**: The "Pair on Phone" developer pairing block is now cleanly gated to iOS 27+, avoiding confusion on older iOS versions.

### 💳 Apple Wallet & Card Customization
• **Interactive Photo Cropper**: Added custom zoom, pan, and framing when selecting card artwork (PR #29).

### 🔒 Passcode Themes (.passthm)
• **UTF-8 Encoding Fix**: Fixed filename encoding in generated passcode theme ZIP archives to support non-ASCII characters and localization (PR #12).

### 🖼 Wallpapers (.tendies)
• **Restored Rock-Solid Wallpaper Engine**: Reverted experimental template tracking to restore proven v1.3 Tendies injection, auto-detection of PosterBoard containers, and instant WebKit NeoSpring resprings.

### ❤️ Developer Support & Links
• **Donate Tab in Credits**: Added direct donation options (PayPal, TON, USDT TRC-20, BEP-20) with one-tap copy and quick links to developer socials (@mak5er).
• **Startup Welcome**: Clean notice highlighting developer credits and quick links.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Mak5er/AirCard-iOS/compare/v1.3...v1.3.1

## What's Changed in v1.3

> **Note**: AirCard-iOS currently supports **iOS 27.0 and newer (iOS 27+)**.

### PosterBoard Wallpapers (.tendies)
• Added support for importing and unpacking `.tendies` wallpaper archives.
• Automatic PosterBoard container detection and active descriptor UUID preservation.
• Integrated instant WebKit NeoSpring respring right after flashing (no device reboot required).

### Apple Wallet & Passcode Theming
• Added PDF artwork generation for transit passes (Suica, Pasmo, etc.).
• Fixed keypad preview framing and TelephonyUI cache paths.
• Cleaned up passcode number localization pickers.
• Removed sluggish button glide animations when scanning cards and copying logs.

### UI & Quality of Life
• Centered action buttons and removed misplaced list divider lines across all tabs.
• Removed disruptive import and install alert popups in favor of clean inline status logs.
• Cleaned up the VPN status bar and removed redundant text labels.
• General repository cleanup and project modernization.

## What's Changed in v1.2.5

### 🛡️ Crash & Memory Fixes
- **Stack Overflow Crash Resolved:** Eliminated crashes on iOS 17/18 during TLS PSK and Tokio handshakes by delegating exploit and syslog routines to dedicated 4MB stack threads.
- **Jetsam OOM Kill Prevention:** SwiftUI card grid now uses memory-efficient 512px thumbnails; full-resolution artwork is loaded on-demand during flash and immediately deallocated.

### 🌐 Network & Tunnel Resilience
- **LocalDevVPN & Loopback Routing:** Restored loopback priority (127.0.0.1, 10.7.0.1, 10.7.0.3) with adaptive 6s timeouts.
- **Local Network Prompt:** Automatically verifies and requests Local Network permissions on launch.

### ⚡ AirTraffic & PassKit Enhancements
- **Airlock Directory Guarantee:** Automatically ensures `/var/mobile/Media/Airlock/Book` exists via AFC, preventing path traversal failures on devices without previous Apple Books syncs.
- **Non-Fatal SyncFailed Handling:** Prevents premature sync terminations caused by delayed background session resets from `com.apple.atc`.
- **Comprehensive Pass Artwork Suite:** Generates full 8-file skin variants (`cardBackgroundCombined`, `diffuse`, `background`, `strip` at @3x and @2x) in a single atomic batch write.
- **Transit & Suica PDF Support:** Restored vector PDF generation (`cardBackgroundCombined.pdf`, `background.pdf`, `strip.pdf`) for complete support of transit and railway passes.
- **Robust Card ID Sanitization:** Automatically cleans pasted paths, quotes, and `.pkpass` extensions to prevent invalid target paths.

apps.subtitle: ResistanceTo（2026-10-13）
apps.localizedDescription: An iPhone battery and charging monitor built on Apple's private APIs: the charger's real watts, how much of that reaches the cell, where the rest goes as heat, and every temperature sensor in the phone. No network code — nothing it reads leaves your phone.

versions.localizedDescription:
Unsigned build — sign it with your own Apple ID before installing.
https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts#install

## 改进

- **输入读数不完整时，不再当作输入功率显示。** 在 iPad Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 上，输入传感器只测到了一部分功率（比如实际 43.5 W 只显示 21.8 W）。现在当进入电芯的功率比输入读数还大时，表盘改为显示"进入电池"的功率，不再计算效率和适配器利用率，并在功率页和适配器页说明原因。
- **电池温度改用中位数。** 部分机型有四个同名的电池温度传感器，其中一个明显偏高。"电池"读数、热力图上的电池标记和分区标题现在都用中位数，四个读数仍然逐个列出。
- **异常温度不再参与计算。** 以下读数不再计入热力图和最高温度，但仍保留在"原始数据"里，并注明原因：低于 −10 °C 的 PMU 传感器、高于 85 °C 而结温对不上的充电芯片温度、恰好为 0.0 °C 的传感器。
- **支持 iPad。** 支持横竖屏，内容不再横向拉满。iPad 的传感器对应关系还没有验证，数据仅供参考。
- **文案更准确。** "来自充电器"改为"手机接口处 / 充电线圈处"；适配器页注明额定功率是协商出的上限，不是功率计读数。
- **原始数据更便于反馈。** 每个传感器带上服务编号，并列出被排除的读数。

## 修复

- 适配器：供电规格列表里不再出现"65.5 V × 65.53 A"这样的无效档位。
- 实时活动：App 在前台时，读数变化 0.05 就会更新，不再等到变化 0.2 W 或 0.5 °C。

## 注意

- 这些修复是根据用户反馈的数据做的，没有在对应机型的真机上验证过。如果你的机型上读数仍然不对，请在 设置 → 原始数据 里复制导出并反馈。
- iPhone 18 Pro Max 高功率充电时的完整输入功率仍然读不到，需要该机型在 45 W 状态下的原始数据导出。
- App 退到后台后，灵动岛上的读数会停住，这是系统限制；想持续看实时读数请使用悬浮表。

---

## Improvements

- **An incomplete input reading is no longer shown as the input.** On an iPad Pro and an iPhone 18 Pro Max the input sensors see only part of the power (21.8 W shown for a real 43.5 W, for one). When more power is reaching the cell than the input reading accounts for, the dial now shows the "into battery" figure, efficiency and adapter utilisation are not worked out, and the Power and Adapter pages say why.
- **Battery temperature is a median.** Some models have four battery temperature sensors under one name, one of them reading clearly high. The Battery readout, the heat map's battery pin and the zone header all use the median now; all four are still listed.
- **Impossible temperatures are left out.** These no longer reach the heat map or the hottest reading, and stay in Raw data with a reason: a PMU sensor below −10 °C, a charge-IC temperature above 85 °C that its junction sensor does not back up, and a sensor at exactly 0.0 °C.
- **iPad support.** All orientations, and content no longer stretches edge to edge. The sensor mapping on iPad is unverified, so treat its numbers with care.
- **More accurate wording.** "From charger" is now "At phone port" / "At charging coil", and the Adapter page says the rating is a negotiated ceiling, not a wall-meter reading.
- **Raw data is easier to report from.** Every sensor carries its service index, and excluded readings are listed.

## Fixes

- Adapter: the profile list no longer shows an invalid "65.5 V × 65.53 A" entry.
- Live Activity: with the app in front, it updates on a 0.05 change instead of waiting for 0.2 W or 0.5 °C.

## Notes

- These fixes were made from data users reported and were not verified on those devices. If readings still look wrong on your model, copy the dump from Settings → Raw data and report it.
- On an iPhone 18 Pro Max the full input power at high-power charging still cannot be read; a Raw data dump taken at 45 W on that model is needed.
- Once the app is in the background the Dynamic Island reading stops. That is a system limit; use the floating meter for a live reading.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1
